title: Callvale after: public and private subnets
claim: The web instance is public; the worker and the database are private.
alt: After: a custom VPC in two Availability Zones with public and private subnets.

edges.say: Users reach the web instance through the internet gateway.
The worker and the database have no public IP addresses.

edges.label: updates
edges.say: The worker downloads updates through the NAT gateway in AZ 1.

edges.label: audio
edges.say: The worker sends audio to Amazon S3 through the gateway endpoint.
The database's security group allows the web and worker security groups.

notes: Brief 10 story pair, after (2-deep.md#decision-record, after Decision). Title, claim, alt, steps from brief.json. Same cells as vpc-before: users A1, Amazon S3 B1, internet gateway A2, web A4, worker B3, database B4 (STARTUP A7 rule 13 in two columns; three do not fit a phone). AZ 2 subnets are empty at month 7. No load balancer, no Amazon RDS. Story numbers only: 10.20.0.0/16, AZ 1, AZ 2. Step 2 sits on the worker-to-database arrow, the one arrow between two private subnets.
